blocks.text: KALIX, a first-in-industry, integrated multi-specialty health hub in Exxa Tower, Bridgetowne, Quezon City, is expanding access to quality healthcare through its accreditation with iCare HMO, one of the Philippines’ leading health insurers. Through the accreditation, eligible iCare members can access a comprehensive range of healthcare services at Kalix, including primary and specialist care, diagnostic and laboratory services, physical therapy, pre-employment and executive medical examinations, and seasonal flu vaccinations, subject to the coverage and requirements of their respective health plans. The partnership makes Kalix another iCare HMO-accredited clinic in Quezon City, serving members in Bridgetowne and nearby Metro Manila communities. Built around […]...
